title: Cooked Strawberry Frozen Yoghurt
changes_from_base: A cooked, sieved strawberry and lemon-zest purée is whisked into thick Greek yoghurt instead of straining plain yoghurt; no golden syrup.
summary: Strawberries cooked down with lemon zest for a deep, jammy flavour, then churned with thick Greek yoghurt.

ingredients.item: lemon, zest peeled off in wide strips
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Put the 500 g strawberries, lemon zest strips, 150 g caster sugar and ⅛ tsp fine salt in a heavy saucepan over medium heat. Stir now and then until the juices begin to simmer, about 4 min.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Lower the heat and cook for about 7 min until juices thicken slightly and berries are very tender.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend the mixture until smooth and pass it through a fine sieve to yield about 480 ml purée.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Whisk the 450 g Greek yoghurt into the purée. If it tastes too sweet, add lemon juice ¼ tsp at a time, remembering that cold mutes both sweet and sour.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Chill the mixture for about 3 h until very cold.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Churn in the ice-cream maker. Eat it as soft serve, or freeze for 2-3 h for a firmer scoop.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: If it has set hard, leave it at room temperature for 10-15 min before scooping.

tips: Slightly overripe strawberries are ideal, as cooking concentrates their flavour.
Strain the purée well so the frozen yoghurt stays silky.
Top with fresh sliced strawberries and a little lemon zest.
storage: Keep in a lidded container in the freezer up to 5 days; soften 10-15 min at room temperature before scooping.
